remembrall.name: Remembrall
remembrall.note: Ask the DM to remind you of one clue

mandrake-leaf.name: Mandrake leaf
mandrake-leaf.note: Key ingredient in the draught that restores drained students

serpent-key.name: Serpent key
serpent-key.note: Opens the door beneath Hogwarts. Only a Parseltongue can turn it

map-half.name: Half of the Marauder’s Map
map-half.note: Torn down the middle. It wakes only for the right words

read.heading: Scratched along the torn edge
pages: I SOLEMNLY SWEAR THAT I AM UP TO NO GOOD
read.footer: Tiny runes in faded ink. Ask the DM to put them on the TV so you can work them out together.

map-other-half.name: The other half of the Marauder’s Map
map-other-half.note: Its torn edge matches the Fenwick half exactly

vale-page.name: Torn page about Corvin Vale
vale-page.note: A painter who wanted to live forever

read.heading: Painters of the Enchanted Canvas, page 212
read.text: …Corvin Vale, whose portraits were said to breathe. His patrons swore the painted eyes followed them home. In his last years Vale grew terribly afraid of dying, and began a self-portrait he vowed he would never finish, “for a finished thing can end.” He was last seen at the castle that paid for his final work. That portrait was never found. Some say he did not die at all, but simply stepped insi—
read.footer: The rest of the page is torn away.

ring-clue-serpent.name: Scratched note (first ring)
ring-clue-serpent.note: “The first ring remembers what sleeps beneath the castle.”

ring-clue-moon.name: Star chart (second ring)
ring-clue-moon.note: “The second ring follows the lamp of the night.”

ring-clue-owl.name: Feathered card (last ring)

diary-page.name: Page of Vale’s diary
diary-page.note: Written in runes. Collect all three.

read.heading: Pages of a diary, in a spiky hand
pages: ONLY THE ONE WHO STANDS ALONE
read.footer: Each rune is always the same letter. With all three pages, show the DM: the whole diary goes up on the TV.

lumos.name: Lumos
lumos.desc: Light in the dark. Reveals invisible ink.

avifors.name: Avifors
avifors.desc: Turns a small object into a flock of birds.

alohomora.name: Alohomora
alohomora.desc: Unlocks a lock if your roll beats its difficulty.

protego.name: Protego
protego.desc: Shield charm. Blocks damage from the next attack on you or an ally.

expelliarmus.name: Expelliarmus
expelliarmus.desc: Disarms the target. On a hit, their next attack misses.

wingardium-leviosa.name: Wingardium Leviosa
wingardium-leviosa.desc: Levitates an object. Heavier things need a higher roll.

accio.name: Accio
accio.desc: Summons an object you can name and see, or know is close.

aguamenti.name: Aguamenti
aguamenti.desc: A jet of water. Puts out fires.

finite-incantatem.name: Finite Incantatem
finite-incantatem.desc: Ends a spell or curse if the roll beats it.

episkey.name: Episkey
episkey.desc: Heals small wounds on yourself or a friend.

rictusempra.name: Rictusempra
rictusempra.desc: Tickling charm. On a hit, the target loses its next turn laughing.

diffindo.name: Diffindo
diffindo.desc: Severing charm. Cuts ropes, vines and bags.

riddikulus.name: Riddikulus
riddikulus.desc: Turns fear into a joke. Only hurts Boggarts.

silencio.name: Silencio
silencio.desc: On a hit, the target can’t cast spells on its next turn.

confundo.name: Confundo
confundo.desc: On a hit, the target attacks the wrong person next turn (GM decides).

immobulus.name: Immobulus
immobulus.desc: On a hit, freezes a creature in place for a round.

petrificus-totalus.name: Petrificus Totalus
petrificus-totalus.desc: Full body-bind. On a hit, the target skips its next turn.

herbivicus.name: Herbivicus
herbivicus.desc: Makes a plant grow and bloom in moments: a vine to climb, a hedge to hide behind, roots to bridge a gap. Bigger plants need a higher roll.

herba-sana.name: Herba Sana
herba-sana.desc: Coaxes a healing herb out of any soil. Whoever eats it heals.

radix-vincula.name: Radix Vincula
radix-vincula.desc: Roots burst out of the ground and grab the target. On a hit, it loses its next turn.

lumos-solem.name: Lumos Solem
lumos-solem.desc: A blaze of sunlight from the wand tip. Devil’s Snare shrivels; it is harmless to everything else.

expecto-patronum.name: Expecto Patronum
expecto-patronum.desc: Your Patronus. Drives back dark creatures and Vale’s servants. Advanced magic, usually learned in Year 3.

avada-kedavra.name: Avada Kedavra
avada-kedavra.desc: The Killing Curse. Kills any creature outright; bosses take 20. If anyone sees, you are expelled.

sectumsempra.name: Sectumsempra
sectumsempra.nat1: Spell rebounds: caster takes Bleed for 3 turns
sectumsempra.source: Advanced Potion-Making (annotated), property of the half-blood prince
sectumsempra.desc: A slashing curse that carves deep wounds, as if by an unseen sword. Countered by Vulnera Sanentur.

levicorpus.name: Levicorpus
levicorpus.source: Advanced Potion-Making (annotated), property of the half-blood prince
levicorpus.desc: Hoists the target into the air by the ankle. They drop what they hold. Countered by Liberacorpus.

liberacorpus.name: Liberacorpus
liberacorpus.source: Advanced Potion-Making (annotated), property of the half-blood prince

langlock.name: Langlock
langlock.nat1: Caster's own tongue sticks: silenced 1 turn
langlock.source: Advanced Potion-Making (annotated), property of the half-blood prince
langlock.desc: Glues the target's tongue to the roof of their mouth.

muffliato.name: Muffliato
muffliato.source: Advanced Potion-Making (annotated), property of the half-blood prince
muffliato.desc: Fills nearby ears with buzzing. NPCs cannot overhear the party; advantage on sneaking for the scene.

vulnera-sanentur.name: Vulnera Sanentur
vulnera-sanentur.desc: A sung counter-curse that knits dark-magic wounds closed. Rare — keep it hard to find.

sanguis-vinculum.name: Sanguis Vinculum
sanguis-vinculum.source: Taught by a teacher or mentor
sanguis-vinculum.desc: Blood Bond. The caster gives any amount of their own HP; an ally heals double. Love-magic, not dark.

cruor-haurire.name: Cruor Haurire
cruor-haurire.nat20: Caster heals the full damage dealt
cruor-haurire.source: Taught by a teacher or mentor
cruor-haurire.desc: Blood Leech. Draws blood from the target to mend the caster.

sanguis-revelio.name: Sanguis Revelio
sanguis-revelio.source: Taught by a teacher or mentor
sanguis-revelio.desc: Reveals blood trails, hidden wounds and blood-sealed doors. Use for tracking and puzzles.

clipeus-cruoris.name: Clipeus Cruoris
clipeus-cruoris.source: Taught by a teacher or mentor
clipeus-cruoris.desc: Blood Shield. Spend 3 HP to fully block the next incoming hit.

confringo.name: Confringo
confringo.nat1: Explodes at the caster's feet: 2 damage to caster
confringo.source: Taught by a teacher or mentor
confringo.desc: Blasting curse. Explodes on impact, splashing 2 damage to anything adjacent.

expulso.name: Expulso
expulso.source: Taught by a teacher or mentor
expulso.desc: An explosive blast that hurls the target backward — into walls, hazards or off ledges.

morsmordre.name: Morsmordre
morsmordre.desc: Conjures the Dark Mark. Enemies roll at disadvantage from fear.

fiendfyre.name: Fiendfyre
fiendfyre.effectLabel: damage to everything caught in it (GM applies)

controlRoll.onFail: Fire spreads to the party: 1d6 each

fiendfyre.desc: Cursed, living fire. Devastating, but the caster must roll to keep control every turn.

stock.name: Toad
stock.desc: +2 max HP. Hops off at the worst moments

stock.name: Rat
stock.desc: +1 DEX. Squeezes through gaps to scout

stock.name: Owl
stock.desc: +1 INT. Delivers items to anyone, anywhere

stock.name: Niffler
stock.desc: +1 DEX. Sniffs out hidden treasure and Galleons

stock.name: Brass cauldron
stock.desc: Brews faster: one extra wheel spin in Potions

stock.name: Gold cauldron
stock.desc: Potions you brew make one extra dose

stock.name: Used book set
stock.desc: Scribbled notes. Required to learn spells

stock.name: Annotated book set
stock.desc: +1 INT, +1 spell damage. Margin notes by a famous witch

protego: Day 5 Defence Against the Dark Arts

brewing.name: Potion brewing
segments: It bubbles over and burns your hand. −2 HP
Small explosion! −3 HP and no eyebrows

curfew.name: Out after curfew
segments: Filch catches you! −10 points and detention
Peeves shrieks your name down the corridor. −5 points
A prefect sees you… and lets it slide
You stumble on a secret passage. +10 XP

misfire.name: Wand misfire
segments: A vase across the shop explodes

gossip.name: Portrait gossip
segments: It tells the whole corridor. Everyone knows
It keeps quiet… for a favour, later

parseltongue.name: They heard you hiss
segments: By dinner, the whole school knows
They report you to a teacher. −5 points

forest.name: Forbidden Forest
segments: A family of Bowtruckles watches from a tree
A THORNBACK BOAR charges! Roll for initiative
A centaur blocks the path. It has questions
A unicorn, silver in the dark. +10 XP
Only fog, and the feeling of being watched
A hippogriff… with a torn Thornbury tag

unforgivable.name: Did anyone see?
segments: A teacher saw the green light.
A portrait saw everything. It may talk…
A ghost drifts away without a word.

castle.name: Hogwarts surprises
segments: The staircase swings away. You’re late for everything
You find a hidden passage. +10 XP
A house-elf slips you a Chocolate Frog
A ghost whispers a rumour about the painting
You find Galleons in an old suit of armour. +5
A portrait winks at you knowingly
